videos.title: Las Audiciones
videos.overview: Ricky decide audicionar para el musical de otoño de East High, "High School Musical", en un esfuerzo por reavivar su relación con su ex novia Nini.

videos.title: La Primera Lectura
videos.overview: EJ está celoso y tambaleándose después de perder el papel principal de "Troy" ante Ricky, y la señorita Jenn le dice a la protagonista en conflicto, Nini, que "confíe en el proceso".

videos.title: Los Suplentes Maravillosos
videos.overview: "Perder" su teléfono y perderse un ensayo importante, Nini sospecha quién es responsable de su combate con mala suerte y sorprendentemente toma represalias. EJ se enfrenta a Ricky por un sincero mensaje de voz que le dejó a Nini. Mientras tanto, el Sr. Mazzara sospecha del pasado de la señorita Jenn.

videos.title: Bloqueos
videos.overview: After Nini discovers that E.J. isn’t who she thinks he is, Ashlyn gets caught in the middle. Gina and E.J. team up as “wonderstudies,” and Ricky gets an unexpected visitor at home.

videos.title: El Baile de Bienvenida
videos.overview: Miss Jenn organizes a girl’s night out with Kourtney and Nini to help Nini shake off the boy drama, while the rest of the theater kids attend the East High Homecoming dance, where Carlos learns to dance like everyone’s watching.

videos.title: ¿Qué Equipo?
videos.overview: When Miss Jenn is placed on temporary leave and rehearsals are put on hold, the students rally together to defend their drama teacher.

videos.title: El Día de Acción de Gracias
videos.overview: A rambunctious Thanksgiving "cast party" at Ashlyn's ends with surprising news for Gina, while Miss Jenn and Mr. Mazzara accidentally spend the holiday together at East High.

videos.title: El Ensayo Técnico
videos.overview: When the cast and crew unexpectedly need to find a new location to "tech" their production, Carlos secures a spooky theater downtown, forcing Miss Jenn to confront old demons.

videos.title: Noche de Estreno
videos.overview: After months of rehearsals, the theater kids gear up for an unforgettable opening night. But when unexpected audience members show up to shake the cast to its core, will the show "go on" if the Wildcats aren't all in this together?

videos.title: Segundo Acto
videos.overview: It's Act Two of opening night, and the stakes have never been higher. After last-minute cast changes in Act One — and so much left unsaid between Ricky and Nini — there's more drama offstage than on

videos.title: Víspera de Año Nuevo
videos.overview: Flying high after the triumph of opening night, Ricky, Nini, Gina, and the Wildcats gather at Ashlyn's for a New Year's Eve party. Miss Jenn runs into the new North High rival theatre teacher—a.k.a her ex-boyfriend—and at the stroke of midnight, shocking revelations come to the surface.

videos.title: Encasillamiento
videos.overview: Kourtney, Carlos and Big Red decide to join their friends and audition for on stage roles in "Beauty and the Beast," while Nini experiences FOMO from afar. When new competition shows up to the tryout, Gina tries to shake off some old habits.

videos.title: San Valentín
videos.overview: Big Red and Ashlyn celebrate their first Valentine's Day together, amidst drama. Kourtney spars with a co-worker while Gina contends with being single. Meanwhile, Ricky and Nini's plans to surprise each other turn into a comedy of errors, leading to new revelations and a surprise song.

videos.title: La Tormenta
videos.overview: When a blizzard barrels down on Salt Lake City, the Wildcats are stranded at East High after hours, just as E.J. receives some bad news. As cabin fever sets in, Miss Jenn inspires Nini to make a bold choice about her future; Kourtney's coworker Howie makes a surprising move; and Gina and Carlos come to blows.

videos.title: La Fiesta de Quince Años
videos.overview: Gina and Seb rally the group to throw Carlos the music and dance-filled Quinceañero he never had. Meanwhile, Ricky accidentally oversteps in more ways than one, and Miss Jenn gets a wild idea about how to get Nini back onstage at East High.

videos.title: Sí, Y...
videos.overview: After rival school North High releases a viral video to undermine the Wildcats, Miss Jenn hosts a weekend improv intensive to build up her kids' confidence. Meanwhile, Nini works on a new song at Salt Lake Slices, where she finds inspiration in Kourtney's approach to life.

videos.title: La Excursión
videos.overview: When the Wildcats suspect that North High has stolen a key costume piece, they infiltrate their rival school and end up in a competitive dance-off. Miss Jenn goes face to face and toe to toe with Zack Roy. And an emboldened Nini takes a big risk.

videos.title: Es Probable
videos.overview: When the Wildcats are benched from rehearsal for a week, tensions rise to the surface during Career Day. Big Red questions if Ashlyn understands his dreams; Howie makes a surprising move with Kourtney; E.J. shocks his dad with a revelation; and Ricky and Nini visit an old haunt.

videos.title: Minivacaciones
videos.overview: When Gina finds herself stranded at the airport over Spring Break, a surprise run-in changes her mind about what she wants. Meanwhile, the separated Wildcats find a way to bond over song during their break, as Ricky finally sees his mom again after their opening night run-in at "High School Musical."

videos.title: La Transformación
videos.overview: After rehearsals fall flat, the cast breaks into separate sleepovers to brainstorm Broadway-worthy ideas to outdo North High. But as the countdown to opening night looms, secrets rise between Nini and Gina, Seb and Carlos suffer their first fight, and Ricky receives an unexpected FaceTime call.

videos.title: Empieza El Show
videos.overview: It's opening night, and Nini hypes up her anxious castmates for their performance in front of the competition judge. But no East High opening night is complete without unexpected visitors, second chances, and big decisions about everyone's futures—together and apart.

videos.title: Una Segunda Oportunidad
videos.overview: While the Wildcats head to Salt Lake Slices to digest the excitement of opening night - and a pizza or two - Miss Jenn continues to experience tunnel vision over the Menkie Awards. Mr. Mazzara shows his softer side; Ricky reevaluates a party crasher; Gina speaks her truth; and Nini makes a life-altering call.

videos.title: Campistas Felices
videos.overview: After a momentous year at East High, the Wildcats head to Camp Shallow Lake for two weeks of fun in the sun. With a high-stakes production of “Frozen” looming and new campers threatening to shake up the Wildcats’ dynamic, the campers are in for an unforgettable summer of highs, lows, and “Let It Go’s.”

videos.title: Mucho Más Allá
videos.overview: A reluctant E.J. takes the reins in a surprisingly new role on "Frozen". New campers bring vocal chops—and competition—to the auditions. In Los Angeles, Nini makes a potentially life-changing discovery of her own.

videos.title: La Mujer del Bosque
videos.overview: After the cast list is revealed, the campers embark on Maddox's favourite camp tradition: Newbie Initiation Night. The centrepiece of the night is a spooky tale that sends Gina and Ricky on a quest into the unknown.

videos.title: Cero Drama
videos.overview: After a spooktacular night in the woods, the cast of "Frozen" have their first read-through. But the Wildcats are in disarray from Corbin Bleu's documentary crew and a camper's sudden disappearance.

videos.title: Los Campistas Reales de Shallow Lake
videos.overview: After promising juicy drama for the "Frozen" documentary, E.J., Carlos and Val plan to turn rehearsals into "The Real Campers of Shallow Lake". But E.J. realizes he may have gone too far when the fake drama pushes some real buttons.

videos.title: La Guerra del Color
videos.overview: After an explosive rehearsal, the Wildcats are divided into rivalries for an annual all-camp competition known as Color War.

videos.title: El Baile
videos.overview: A throwback '70s-themed prom unexpectedly inspires everyone to look to the future.

videos.title: Libre Soy
videos.overview: Nerves run high on the opening night of "Frozen" as the documentary's release quickly approaches.

videos.title: High School Musical 4
videos.overview: Disney announces that "High School Musical 4: High School Reunion" will be shooting at East High.

videos.title: HSM v. HSM
videos.overview: The Wildcats contend with High School Musical 3 auditions AND High School Musical 4 rehearsal.

videos.title: Ha Nacido una Estrella
videos.overview: High School Musical 4 pulls focus from High School Musical 3 as one of the Wildcats has a star-is-born moment.

videos.title: Trick or Treat
videos.overview: At Gina's Halloween party, relationships are put to the test and secrets are revealed.

videos.title: Admissions
videos.overview: With Ricky and Kourtney off to college and the other Wildcats distracted, the musical is in peril.

videos.title: Trust the Process
videos.overview: The Wildcats revisit the past in order to secure the future of the theater program.

videos.title: The Night of Nights
videos.overview: Ricky, Gina, and the rest of the Wildcats must make big decisions on opening night of HSM 3.

videos.title: Born to Be Brave
videos.overview: Act Two of HSM 3 Opening Night is shaken up by surprise guests and looming decisions.

videos.title: High School Musical
videos.overview: Troy y Gabriela se conocen en un karaoke durante las vacaciones. Troy es una estrella de baloncesto, y Gabriela es la nueva estudiante. Al volver al colegio, se presentan al casting para el musical de la escuela, pero deben superar varios obstáculos.

videos.title: High School Musical 2
videos.overview: Llegaron las vacaciones de verano y los linces ya están listos para disfrutar el tiempo libre durante su trabajo de verano en el club country de la familia Evans.

videos.title: High School Musical 3: Senior Year
videos.overview: As seniors in high school, Troy and Gabriella struggle with the idea of being separated from one another as college approaches. Along with the rest of the Wildcats, they stage a spring musical to address their experiences, hopes and fears about their future.

videos.title: The Special
videos.overview: An exclusive look into the making of High School Musical: The Musical: The Series.

videos.title: The Holiday Special
videos.overview: The actors of the series will immerse you in the holiday spirit with their interpretations of Christmas carols, popular hits, not to mention a medley of Chanukah carols. They will also share anecdotes related to their childhood memories - from the best to the most embarrassing - but also gifts, favorite end-of-year traditions, family photos and good resolutions.
